Type
Company
Adhesive useKimberly-Clark

I cut adhesive use by 40% on 5 diaper machines, saving about $200K a year. It meant lowering each of the 110 adhesive applications, with their matching quality tests, across all 12 products.

−40%
Process stability on 7 linesKimberly-Clark

The 7 lines are the 5 machines that were already running plus 2 new lines installed after the adhesive project. The new lines started with the lower adhesive weight already set, then it was tuned until it was roughly the same as in the other, analogous applications. Getting there meant standardizing mechanical, electrical and software equipment. Follow-on results:

  • Scrap in the adhesive area went from 2% to 1.3%, a 35% reduction: the stability gain behind this bar. Where it affected other areas, scrap dropped between 0.5% and 1.5%.
  • Changeovers went from 6–8 minutes to 3–5 minutes.
  • Monthly spare-parts cost in the adhesive area dropped 15%.
  • Overall scrap per machine was usually below 5%.
+35%
Time-to-market on the Tesla lineAir International

I launched line 2 of the Tesla HVAC assembly in under 3 weeks, the fastest launch in the company. It went from zero to 250 pieces per shift by the end of the ramp-up.

+40%
Blower line cycle timeAir International

Blower line optimization for scalable VW production. The 25% cycle time reduction came from deep 5S, very clear SOPs, constant training for 2 weeks and autonomous maintenance.

−25%
Operator errorsAir International

Smart workstations with real-time monitoring and better operator interfaces made mistakes at the station less frequent.

−30%
Leak-test failuresAir International

A custom in-house fixture design fixed bad measurements in the leak test and reduced the number of units that failed it. The failures that remain are tied to supplier material that does not pass the test.

−60%
Output at smart workstationsAir International

The same smart workstation upgrade: real-time monitoring and interface improvements raised what each station produced.

+200%

Aura Logic product

ProTRACK: monitoring that runs beside your control system

A non-intrusive industrial data-acquisition and monitoring system. It works in parallel to any PLC or controller, even on legacy infrastructure or closed systems, with no stoppages and no costly migrations.

  • Monitor
  • Analyze
  • Alert

How the data gets from the machine to the screen

Five layers, and nothing in your current control system has to change.

  1. 1

    Production

    Conveyors, motors, robots, production lines, warehouses and general machinery.

  2. 2

    Data capture

    Wireless nodes read the signals from each machine.

  3. 3

    Data reception

    A receiver collects the node data and passes it to the PC over USB.

  4. 4

    Storage and management

    A local PC stores and manages the data, with an encrypted backup.

  5. 5

    Visualization and decisions

    Dashboards on local monitors, or on a mobile app through an encrypted web/VPN link.

Why teams choose it

No migrations

Avoids changes to the existing control system.

Universal compatibility

Supports multiple protocols and brands.

Scalable

Starts with a few sensors and grows with your needs.

Independence

Runs autonomously, without costly software licenses.

Failure prevention

Early alerts that reduce unplanned stoppages.

Where it fits

  • Plants with obsolete PLC/SCADA
  • Real-time supervision of critical areas
  • Environmental control in sensitive processes
  • Temporary monitoring in pilot projects
  • Extra monitoring for quality audits
  • Machine performance analysis for predictive maintenance
